description:
About this space
Stylish & comfortable self-catering apartments offer a home away from home in a leafy suburb in Johannesburg.

Fully furnished 71 m² two-bedroom units feature a main bedroom with queen-size bed & en-suite bathroom including shower & bathtub.

Second bedroom has a double bed & second bathroom has a bathtub.

Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances, a lounge, dining area & large balcony. Smart TV, with Netflix, DSTV, Showmax & Amazon Prime Video ready (Own Login), dedicated workspace.

The space
A short walk away from The Wedge shopping centre, the apartment is located only 5 km from Sandton City Mall & Nelson Mandela Square Africa’s most iconic shopping centre and Sandton Business Hub.

The building consists of lift and stairs, 24/7 Security on site and 12-hour reception and concierge services (08h00 – 20h00).

Secure on-site basement parking, Unlimited Wi-Fi, Digital management front door locks, Cleaning services: 3-6 nights once during stay, 7+ nights every third day and long stays 28+ nights twice a week, Backup power & water.

Guest access
On arrival inform security you checking in and going to CAG reception.

At front desk on duty receptionist will provide you with code to enter apartment and Wi-Fi password. Proof of identification (ID/Passport) will be required and sign registration card which includes our house rules.
